cohort.name: Luka Dončić
cohort.direct_assessment: On-ball physical imposition, every-pass playmaking, P&R/isolation and huge shotmaking; reduced rim access/longer shot distance, health, defensive targeting; island coverage can reduce team offense.
cohort.reasonable_implication: Repeated probing/space creation and broad passing repertoire support uncertain family-specific estimates. Every-pass praise supports breadth, not separately measured pass types or turnover causes. No specific cross-court distinction is supported here, so F07 remains unknown.
cohort.speaker: unidentified/local turn
cohort.material_event_audit: not newly performed; healthy ability vs availability separate

cohort.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
cohort.direct_assessment: Exceptional isolation/P&R, rim/FT pressure, turnover suppression, improving playmaking and positive defense; loaded playoff defenses reduced dominance.
cohort.reasonable_implication: Scoring craft and security are clearer than any particular pass family; improving passing is not evidence of Luka-level breadth or a measured steal technique.
cohort.speaker: unidentified/local turn
cohort.material_event_audit: not newly performed; healthy ability vs availability separate

cohort.name: Jalen Brunson
cohort.direct_assessment: High-volume/clutch scoring and turnover suppression; passing below elite engine comparisons, defensive liability insulated by Knicks infrastructure.
cohort.reasonable_implication: Scoring creation/security can be strong without all-world reads. Reduced-defense conclusion does not independently diagnose inattention or physical speed.
cohort.speaker: unidentified/local turn
cohort.material_event_audit: not newly performed; healthy ability vs availability separate

cohort.name: Cade Cunningham
cohort.direct_assessment: High-load big-guard creation amid poor spacing; physical/creative crowded-paint play and difficult defensive assignment; high turnovers, inside/pull-up consistency and growth uncertainty.
cohort.reasonable_implication: Creation/defense and turnover concern coexist. Turnovers have unknown cause; a broad security concern is a hypothesis, not proved dribbling losses.
cohort.speaker: unidentified/local turn
cohort.material_event_audit: not newly performed; healthy ability vs availability separate

cohort.name: Darius Garland
cohort.direct_assessment: Elite handle/change of pace/quickness, P&R and passing, on/off-ball shooting and floater; physical playoff translation, rim/FT limitations, small-guard defense and repeated injury concerns.
cohort.reasonable_implication: Manipulation, craft and roll/kick reads are plausible; raw security under pressure is less directly established. Healthy quickness is not injury-adjusted speed.
cohort.speaker: unidentified/local turn
cohort.material_event_audit: not newly performed; healthy ability vs availability separate

cohort.name: Dylan Harper
cohort.direct_assessment: Size, handle, pace, body control, paint access/varied finishes, strong security and stabilizing decisions; useful defense; advanced passing reads and perimeter shot need growth.
cohort.reasonable_implication: Present craft/security can exceed advanced read breadth. Delivery may be adequate for simple kick windows; a higher delivery midpoint is a hypothesis, not an observed dissociation.
cohort.speaker: unidentified/local turn
cohort.material_event_audit: not newly performed; healthy ability vs availability separate

cohort.name: Desmond Bane
cohort.direct_assessment: Shooting, straight-line physical drives, touch and passing; pressure/switching, inside finishing and separation limit playoffs; exceptional opponents are counterweight.
cohort.reasonable_implication: Separation and pressure manipulation can lag shooting. These failures do not by themselves establish poor handle security or inaccurate kick passes.
cohort.speaker: unidentified/local turn
cohort.material_event_audit: not newly performed; healthy ability vs availability separate

cohort.name: Stephon Castle
cohort.direct_assessment: Elite POA defense/star assignments, downhill pressure and useful playmaking; turnovers/scoring limits, high fouls and weaker off-ball/secondary-help disruption; Wembanyama support matters.
cohort.reasonable_implication: Containment and contact craft likely strong. Helper recognition/attention/foul-control decomposition is less certain. Turnover concern is not a labeled lost-ball sample.
cohort.speaker: unidentified/local turn
cohort.material_event_audit: not newly performed; healthy ability vs availability separate

cohort.name: Derrick White
cohort.direct_assessment: Defensive anticipation/positioning, POA pressure and guard rim playmaking; good decisions/passing/handling, low turnovers; weak inside self-creation and poor shooting season.
cohort.reasonable_implication: Secure connector with early help reads need not be primary drive creator. Blocks/on-off are corroborating context, not direct timing or IQ measurements.
cohort.speaker: unidentified/local turn
cohort.material_event_audit: not newly performed; healthy ability vs availability separate

cohort.name: Scottie Barnes
cohort.direct_assessment: Lead/playoff creation growth, short-range scoring, elite passing and defensive versatility/hands, guards/wings POA plus help/rim protection; inconsistent threes and lead-scoring ceiling.
cohort.reasonable_implication: Strong help/containment and drive-to-pass hypotheses. Elite passing does not independently establish lob, skip and pocket subskills; only limited family estimates are offered.
cohort.speaker: unidentified/local turn
cohort.material_event_audit: not newly performed; healthy ability vs availability separate

cohort.name: Rudy Gobert
cohort.direct_assessment: Elite rim coverage/consistency, successful post-defense and ability to switch/defend space; severe offensive limitations, expected improved involvement with creator.
cohort.reasonable_implication: Pass-dependent finishing is an opportunity contrast, not poor receiving or lob-technique proof. Anchor value supports spatial awareness broadly, not automatic elite perimeter containment.
cohort.speaker: unidentified/local turn
cohort.material_event_audit: not newly performed; healthy ability vs availability separate

cohort.name: Bam Adebayo
cohort.direct_assessment: Excellent versatile switching defense, playmaking/creation and availability; inefficient jumper-heavy offense, future Giannis fit uncertain; Chet has greater rim deterrence.
cohort.reasonable_implication: Switching supports containment/contact hypotheses with tools confounded. Generic playmaking does not identify pocket/lob delivery; connector estimates are safer than all-family copying.
